infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Monarch Prime Pin uses your photo library to attach progress photos to your log entries.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Monarch Prime Pin saves progress photos to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Monarch Prime Pin uses your camera to capture progress photos for your log entries.

plugins.photosPermission: Monarch Prime Pin accesses your photos to attach progress photos to your log entries.
plugins.cameraPermission: Monarch Prime Pin uses your camera to capture progress photos for your log entries.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Monarch Prime Pin reads your body weight and body fat percentage to show them next to your records and in Reports. The data stays on your phone.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Monarch Prime Pin only reads from Apple Health and never writes to it.
